events.title: MTV Launches with Buggles' Video
events.blurb: MTV launched on this day in 1981 with the Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Turns 45
angles.copy: Today in 1981, MTV changed music forever, launching with the Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star, a song that would become synonymous with the dawn of the music video era.

events.title: Oasis Release Definately Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis' debut album Definately Maybe was released on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Classic Turns 32
angles.copy: On this day in 1994, Oasis released their debut album Definately Maybe, a defining moment in the Britpop movement.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Took Place
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love, and Music
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival, a moment that defined a generation and the music of the 1960s.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis' Death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today we remember Elvis Presley, who left an indelible mark on music, passing away on this day in 1977.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot Dead
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, Tupac Shakur's life was tragically cut short, but his music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix' Death
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix' Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix, a guitar legend who left an indelible mark on music before his tragic passing on this day in 1970.

events.title: Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on this day in 1969.

angles.name: A Legendary Album Turns 57
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, the Beatles gave the world Abbey Road, one of the most influential albums in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the lead singer of the Pretenders, turns 75 today.

angles.name: A Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Chrissie Hynde, the voice behind the Pretenders, turns 75 today, a celebration of a life dedicated to music and iconic hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the Oasis frontman, turns 54 today.

angles.name: The Voice of Oasis
angles.copy: Liam Gallagher, the iconic voice of Oasis, turns 54 today, a celebration of his contributions to the Britpop movement.

events.title: John Lennon Releases Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine on this day in 1971.

angles.name: A Timeless Album Turns 55
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave the world Imagine, an album that has become a beacon of peace and unity.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary Beatle, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: John Lennon, a Beatle and a solo artist, would have been 86 today, a tribute to his enduring legacy in music and peace activism.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the comedic legend, turns 87 today.

angles.name: A Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: John Cleese, known for Monty Python and countless comedic roles, turns 87 today, celebrating a life of laughter and entertainment.

events.title: Beatles Release The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album, commonly known as the White Album, on this day in 1968.

angles.name: A Revolutionary Album Turns 58
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, the Beatles pushed the boundaries of music with the release of their self-titled album, known to fans as the White Album.
